results.name: AArete Names Healthcare Leader Pam Shipley as CEO - AArete
results.content:
# AArete Names Healthcare Executive Pam Shipley as Chief Executive Officer  
*Global consulting firm’s founder Loren Trimble to step down after 18 years of growth and recognized excellence*  
**CHICAGO**–([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260810294659/en/AArete-Names-Healthcare-Executive-Pam-Shipley-as-Chief-Executive-Officer))–[AArete](https://www.aarete.com/), a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the appointment of Pam Shipley as chief executive officer. A Fortune 25 healthcare executive with more than 30 years of experience, Shipley succeeds AArete Founder Loren Trimble, who will transition from his role as CEO to board member.  
Shipley joins AArete from Centene Corporation, a leading managed care organization, in which she most recently served as chief strategy officer. She spent nearly 14 years at Centene over two tenures where she held multiple CEO roles in Georgia, Missouri and Mississippi and led digital transformation and market expansion across more than 15 markets.
AArete drives profitability improvement, digital transformation and AI solutions for clients across a range of industries, including the healthcare payer segment, which has become the firm’s signature strength. The firm advises on U.S. health plans of every type, including Medicaid, Medicare, ACA Marketplace and commercial, helping clients manage the total cost of care and expand affordability without sacrificing quality or the member experience. In 2025, AArete secured a strategic investment from Parthenon Capital, a growth-oriented private equity firm with deep experience backing healthcare solutions and technology companies, further strengthening the firm’s continued growth.  
“What we’ve built at AArete would not be possible without a culture built on integrity, excellence and care for the people we serve, and I’m proud that Pam will continue that legacy,” Trimble said. “She’s a purpose-driven leader whose passion for people and delivering results for clients reflects the values of the firm. I am confident she will lead AArete into its next chapter and build on its success.”
Trimble established AArete in 2008 with the goal of building a consulting firm that nurtures long-term client partnerships. Under his leadership, AArete grew into a global firm with more than 500 team members, earning recognition as a [Forbes World’s Best Management Consulting Firm](https://www.forbes.com/lists/worlds-best-management-consulting-firms/) for four consecutive years and a [USA Today Top Workplaces Award](https://topworkplaces.com/company/aarete/), underscoring the firm’s strong culture and people-first approach.  
“AArete has become an essential partner to many of the nation’s leading health plans, and Pam is exactly the right leader to build on the firm’s momentum going forward,” said Dan Killeen, partner at Parthenon Capital. “Her payer expertise and track record of driving growth and performance make her uniquely suited to lead AArete into the future. We are grateful to Loren for his visionary leadership and look forward to his continued engagement as a member of the board.”

results.name: Loren Trimble Wins Consulting Lifetime Achievement - AArete
results.content:
# AArete CEO Loren Trimbleto Receive Lifetime Achievement Award Honoring 4 Decades of Consulting Excellence  
**CHICAGO, April 23, 2026 –** [AArete](https://www.aarete.com/), a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today that founder and CEO Loren Trimble has been named a recipient of a Lifetime Achievement award from Consulting Magazine as part of its [Top Consultants 2026](https://www.consultingmag.com/2026/04/20/consulting-magazine-unveils-2026-top-consultant-honorees/) awards. The award will honor Trimble’s four-decade career in consulting and 18 years leading AArete.  
Trimble will receive the award during a June 25 ceremony at the Marriott Marquis in New York City. Consulting Magazine’s Top Consultants 2026 awards spotlight the consulting profession’s most influential senior leaders, whose work produces measurable client impact, advances firm capabilities and shapes the industry.  
> Maulik Bhagat, EVP & Senior Managing Director
>
> *Excellence is a core value he lives out every single day. He built this firm on a foundation of genuine care for clients and colleagues alike, and our culture flows directly from his leadership*
Trimble established AArete in 2008 with the goal of building a consulting firm that nurtures long-term client partnerships, choosing the firm’s name after a Greek word that embodies excellence, goodness and virtue. Over the past 18 years, AArete has grown into a global management and technology consulting firm that is more than 500 team members strong. In 2025, AArete entered a strategic partnership with [Parthenon Capital](https://www.parthenoncapital.com/) to accelerate solution innovation for clients and position the firm for transformational growth.  
“Loren’s leadership sets the standard for who we are at AArete,” said **Duane Harrington,** executive vice president and senior managing director at AArete. “He brings our vision and mission to life every day through his decisions, his integrity and his unwavering commitment to our people and clients. We are grateful for the example he sets and the culture of purpose and excellence he continues to build.”  
Over the past 18 years, AArete has built deep expertise serving U.S. health plans of all sizes, including Medicaid, Medicare, ACA Marketplace and commercial plans. AArete is a trusted total cost of care advisor to payers who are working to reduce trend and improve affordability without compromising quality or the member experience.
The firm’s AI-enabled proprietary solutions include provider contract, policy and benefit intelligence, powered by the patented [Doczy.ai™](https://www.aarete.com/industry/healthcare/payer/doczy-ai-for-healthcare-payers/), and [AArete Payment Intelligence®](https://payment-intelligence.aarete.com/), which goes beyond traditional payment integrity, by identifying and fixing root causes across the entire payment ecosystem to unlock value and deliver a clear ROI.  
Under Loren’s leadership, AArete has been named a [Forbes World’s Best Consulting Firm](https://www.forbes.com/lists/worlds-best-management-consulting-firms/) four years in a row in the categories of Healthcare, Digital Transformation, Data Analytics and Big Data. AArete was also recognized as a [Top Workplace](https://www.aarete.com/insights/aarete-earns-usa-today-top-workplaces-2025-award/) in 2026 by USA Today, based upon an independent employee survey.
